title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics, parity fixes, bump v1.194.0
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: bring the Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to parity for auth retries, streaming ergonomics, and align retry/backoff behaviour across languages. This PR unifies the auth token refresh logic, standardizes retry semantics (idempotency hints + exponential backoff defaults), improves streaming API ergonomics (consistent async iterator / callback surface), fixes a handful of parity bugs discovered during cross-language QA, and bumps SDK versions to v1.194.0.

Summary of changes: unified AuthManager interface, plumbed retry middleware into HTTP clients for all SDKs, added streaming convenience helpers (stream.toAsyncIterator for TS, stream.Iter for Python, stream.Reader for Go), tightened type annotations and improved docs/examples.

Checklist: - [x] Python: auth refresh + retry middleware + streaming iterator - [x] TypeScript: auth plugin + retry middleware + readable stream ergonomics - [x] Go: token provider + retry policy + stream Reader API - [x] Integration tests across SDKs - [x] Updated CHANGELOGs and release scripts - [x] Manual verification with live hosted API (smoke test)

Compatibility notes: defaults change for retries (max_attempts from 3 -> 4, base_backoff from 0.1s -> 0.2s) to better tolerate transient infra failures; old behavior can be restored by setting retry.policy = "legacy" in client config. Streaming surface changes are additive and backward compatible for existing call sites that use raw Response.body; new ergonomics are opt-in behind feature flags for one release to reduce regression risk.

Testing: added unit tests and e2e smoke-tests that exercise token refresh under concurrent requests, simulate 429/503 transient errors to validate retry behavior, and exercise streaming cancellation semantics. CI matrix executed across Python 3.10/3.11, Node 18/20, Go 1.20/1.21.

Related: ENG-4123 (unify retry behaviour), ENG-4210 (streaming ergonomics), PM-98 (release coordination).

release_notes:
- SDKs: unified auth/retry behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go
- SDKs: improved streaming ergonomics with new helpers (toAsyncIterator / Iter / Reader)
- Defaults: retry max_attempts bumped to 4, base_backoff increased; legacy policy available
- Bugfixes: parity fixes for streaming cancellation and token refresh race conditions
- Version bump: all SDK packages -> v1.194.0
migration_instructions: Developers using SDKs should: 1) scan CHANGELOG for retry default changes, 2) opt-in legacy retry policy if behaviour must remain unchanged, 3) update streaming callsites to use new convenience helpers when/if desired. See docs/CHANGELOG.md and docs/migration/sdks-v1.194.0.md for examples.
notes: This PR was coordinated across SDK owners; release gating toggles were used to roll out streaming ergonomics as opt-in for 48 hours before enabling by default. No customer-facing incidents observed during rollout.
